# Presets

<!-- Generated by ConfigReferenceTest from the Kotlin source: edit the KDoc, then run ./gradlew updateReference. -->

A preset sets every value below; the block of `meshLinkConfig` or `Preset.Custom` overrides any of them. A preset is local to a node: nodes with different presets form one mesh, and every node relays every other node's frames. No preset sets background behavior. See [Configuration](configuration.md) for what each value does.

## Built-in presets

- `OfflineChat`: Text chat between people without a network: unicast and broadcast, holding for others, read receipts, 30 min lifetime, 128 KiB messages.
- `EmergencyBroadcast`: Alerts that must reach as many nodes as possible: `PresetSettings.broadcastPriority` on, holding for others, no read receipts, 1 h lifetime, 4 KiB messages.
- `ProximityDiscovery`: Finding who is nearby: direct-only unicast, no holding, no read receipts, 120 s lifetime, 4 KiB messages, `Power.Responsive`.
- `LocalMultiplayer`: Games between players in one room: density pinned to `DensityClass.Low` for the lowest latency, no holding, no read receipts, 120 s lifetime, 128 KiB messages, `Power.Responsive`.
- `FieldTeams`: Teams spread over an area, such as rescue crews: unicast and broadcast, holding for others, read receipts, 1 h lifetime, 128 KiB messages.

## Values

| Setting | `OfflineChat` | `EmergencyBroadcast` | `ProximityDiscovery` | `LocalMultiplayer` | `FieldTeams` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `density` | `Automatic` | `Automatic` | `Automatic` | `Pinned(Low)` | `Automatic` |
| `power` | `Balanced` | `Balanced` | `Responsive` | `Responsive` | `Balanced` |
| `routedUnicast` | `true` | `true` | `false` | `true` | `true` |
| `broadcastOrigination` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| `broadcastPriority` | `false` | `true` | `false` | `false` | `false` |
| `holding` | `true` | `true` | `false` | `false` | `true` |
| `messageLifetimeSeconds` | `1800` | `3600` | `120` | `120` | `3600` |
| `readReceipts.requestByDefault` | `true` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `true` |
| `readReceipts.send` | `true` | `false` | `false` | `false` | `true` |
| `limits.maxUnicastPayload` | `131072` | `4096` | `4096` | `131072` | `131072` |
| `limits.maxBroadcastPayload` | `1024` | `1024` | `1024` | `1024` | `1024` |

## `Custom`

An app's own preset: `base`'s values with `overrides` applied. `meshLinkConfig`'s `MeshLinkConfigBuilder.build` validates the result.

```kotlin
val quietChat = Preset.Custom("Quiet chat", Preset.OfflineChat) { readReceipts.send = false }
```
